verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://documentation.datalab.to/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown pages. Many doc pages are also served as raw .md, including the API reference, SDK, CLI and webhooks pages, so an agent can ingest the docs directly. Missing for 10: no first-party page explaining or promoting agent/LLM doc consumption (e.g. llms-full.txt or 'use with AI' guidance), no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths, and no independent reports of agents using these docs.
